(rule!
  (reduce (lambda (out obj)
    (if (not (= (obj-color obj) 3)) out
      ;; Bounding box (r1 c1 r2 c2) of obj
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             ;; Top edge (row r1)
             (r0 (first bb))
             ;; Left edge (col c1)
             (c0 (second bb))
             ;; Bottom edge (row r2)
             (r1 (third bb))
             ;; Right edge (col c2)
             (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (reduce (lambda (acc r)
          (reduce (lambda (acc2 c)
            (if (and (= (cell-at g r c) 3)
                     (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1)))
              (set-cell acc2 r c 8)
              acc2))
            acc (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
          out (range r0 (+ r1 1))))))
    g (objects g 0)))

(rule!
  (let* ((greens (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 3)) (objects g 0)))
         (target (first (reverse (sort-by greens (lambda (obj) (obj-size obj))))))
         (bb (obj-bbox target))
         (r0 (first bb))
         (c0 (second bb))
         (r1 (third bb))
         (c1 (fourth bb)))
    (reduce (lambda (out r)
      (reduce (lambda (out2 c)
        (if (and (= (cell-at g r c) 3)

          (set-cell out2 r c 8)
          out2))
        out (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
      g (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
